descriptions.d15b_resize_rope_segments_800ccdd8: Resize the ninja rope's retained segment array. When growing, for each new slot look up a segment by the original NinjaRope.Rope name (limit 255) through a temporary string, grow the array by one, assign the segment with retain-before-release ownership, increment the count and release the local handle. When shrinking, release and clear every slot past the new count, then resize the array. Unsigned comparisons; partial native GC32 layouts; string referenced by address; no owned initialized data.
